construction_independence: Author did not read controller_cases11.py or a root oracle implementation; expected answers follow the policies below.

P_PARENT.scope: Finite parent scheduling fixture; this is not an OpenClaw replacement executor.
rules: A matching known child that is running is not dispatched again after a client timeout; wait using its existing ID if one call remains.
A matching child that has an observed FAILED terminal receipt is inspected by its existing ID, rather than automatically redispatched.
A completed child without its required artifact receipt is inspected using its existing ID; DONE alone is insufficient.
A completed child with its coherent required artifact receipt may advance to artifact review; receipt presence alone does not establish utility.
Budget is a hard pre-dispatch bound. If remaining_calls is zero, issue no new native call, record HOLD_BUDGET and preserve existing child references.

If no matching child exists and remaining_calls equals the declared next_call_cost, exactly one dispatch is permitted. Zero remaining calls after that dispatch is valid; no subsequent call is implied.

P_VERSION.scope: Evidence eligibility for one requested synthetic artifact version, not a utility judgement.
rules: Producer declaration and artifact receipt must identify the same artifact before consumer evidence is accepted.
Only consumer evidence bound to requested_version, case and input is eligible. A previous version's success or failure does not label a later version.
If a coherent current artifact lacks its own consumer retest and one retest call remains, request a version-specific retest rather than declaring KEEP.
READY_FOR_COMPARISON means only that these version prerequisites are satisfied. It is not real qualified KEEP.

P_PAIRING.scope: Eligibility of synthetic NS/skill comparison records, not benefit scoring.
rules: Pair by case identity, not array position. Each pair needs equal original input, model, environment and evaluation policy.
The skill receipt must identify the requested artifact version.
Different IDs with the same original input digest count once toward minimum_independent_inputs.
Missing or unequal pairing keys yield HOLD. No similarity heuristic repairs a mismatch.

P_Q_OBSERVABILITY.scope: Finite synthetic admission gate; thresholds are fixture assumptions, not calibrated WRD production policy.
rules: Each of five skill Q dimensions must be known and at least 80. Equality is allowed.
A null Q or cost component is UNKNOWN, never zero. Explicit numeric zero is a known valid value.
A failed required delivery check is a delivery defect even if the process exit code is zero and the independent Q vector is high.

For these four fixture questions a known delivery or below-floor defect is assigned the next-stage disposition REVISE. This recommends a repair review and does not claim a repair was executed or guaranteed feasible. Preserve measured Q separately; do not multiply it by delivery success.
QUALITY_ADMISSIBLE or EVIDENCE_COMPLETE means only this gate passed, not that utility or real KEEP has been established.

P_NET_BENEFIT.scope: Finite fixed-usage synthetic economic decision; all included costs are known and have identical abstract cost units.
rules: Required delivery and quality non-inferiority must hold. A candidate with lower Q and greater total cost is dominated and stopped in this fixture; no repair option is assumed.
Net benefit equals planned_uses times (baseline_per_use minus skill_per_use) minus total_one_time_cost.
KEEP_FIXTURE requires strictly positive net benefit, not greater-than-or-equal to zero. Exact break-even yields STOP.
Fixture KEEP is a policy answer to constructed facts; it never increases observed qualified skill count.

P_PARETO.scope: A separate explicitly requested Pareto policy, deliberately different from P_NET_BENEFIT.
rules: Delivery must pass, every Q dimension must be no lower and lifetime total cost no greater than baseline.
At least one Q dimension or lifetime total cost must improve strictly. Quality improvement at equal known zero cost qualifies under this policy.
Do not grade this case by a cash-benefit-only oracle without acknowledging the policy mismatch. KEEP_FIXTURE is not observed qualified KEEP.

P_ACCOUNTING.scope: Accounting answer only; REPORT/UNDEFINED is not an actor KEEP/HOLD/STOP ontology.
rules: K is the number of distinct qualifying final artifact digests, not names, versions, receipts or consumer runs.
Sum each physical cost_event_id once. Allocation references distribute an existing event and do not add a second payment.
If any required physical cost is null, total and per-qualified cost are unknown; no lower bound is presented as exact total.
If K equals zero, per-qualified cost is undefined with null numerical value, even when total is known. It is neither zero nor a claimed measured infinity.
For positive K and fully known costs, per-qualified cost equals total physical cost divided by K.
